frequency_question: What proportion of major partisan bills successfully pass the Senate within a single 336-day operational window from introduction?
membership_rule: Includes major bills with explicit partisan alignment that underwent committee process or direct placement on calendar; excludes routine non-controversial bills, unanimous consent measures, and must-pass appropriations.

cases.name: Border Security and Asylum Reform Act (118th)

coverage_note: 10 named cases representing major partisan or high-profile domestic legislative pushes across the 117th and 118th Congresses.
known_gaps: Excludes dozens of minor or purely symbolic resolutions that never received substantive committee attention.
skeleton: Not applicable; enumerated direct case outcomes.
multiplier: 4 hits out of 10 named representative major partisan vehicles = 0.40
validity_reason: Remains stable through the duration of the current and immediate subsequent congressional terms, as Senate procedural rules and filibuster requirements are persistent.
